name: io.github.Bossmann007/curitibai
title: CuritibAI
description: Unofficial read-only MCP server for public data about Curitiba, Brazil.

environmentVariables.name: CURITIBAI_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder with the files you download for the local-data tools (URBS exports, CSVs, catalog copy). Optional.

environmentVariables.name: CURITIBAI_REMOTE_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0, off, false or no to stop reading the published events and phones copy from GitHub and stop bus_stops_near from reading the GeoCuritiba stop layer. 1, on, true or yes (or unset) leave it on; any other value stops the server. Optional.
